title: Israeli Settlers Are Blocking Palestinian Children From Going to School With Barbed Wire
author: Team Zeteo
content:
On April 13, students in the occupied West Bank village of Umm al-Khair woke
up to a new reminder of the occupation that surrounds them: barbed wire and
Israeli flags blocking the only path they take to school.

**" Even animals can't just pass this obstacle,"** community leader and human
rights activist Eid Suleiman tells **Zeteo**.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

For weeks, the children of Umm al-Khair have been protesting the one right
they thought was universal, protected, and cherished by global society: the
right to an education.

**" I can't… tell the 6-year-old kid to walk through all these obstacles and
go to his school and be safe,"** says Suleiman, who adds this is just one of
the many ways Israel is tearing down Palestine's education system. **" We
should, if we can, find the support for these students and help them to keep
their education."**

_**Zeteo 's** Mohammed Abdelbary contributed to this reporting. _
